strings.name: Ren Zhengfei
strings.summary: Raised in a Guizhou teaching family, Ren studied construction engineering in Chongqing and served in the military engineering corps. He founded Huawei in Shenzhen in 1987, later becoming CEO. Teams and sustained investment enabled its move from switch sales to telecommunications research and international markets. Global expansion also brought cybersecurity disputes and US export restrictions.
